title: Remove Sub-Folders from the Filesystem
description: Given a list of folders, remove all sub-folders in those folders and return the remaining folders.
pseudocode:
1. folder.sort()
2. result = [folder[0]]
3. for i = 1 to folder.length - 1:
4.   last = result[result.length - 1] + '/'
5.   if not folder[i].startsWith(last):
6.     result.push(folder[i])
7. return result

steps.note: Sort the folders lexicographically to ensure parent folders appear before sub-folders.
Initialize result with the first folder.
Check if '/a/b' is a sub-folder of '/a'. Prefix check with '/' added.
Check if '/c/d' is a sub-folder of '/a'.
'/c/d' is not a sub-folder. Add to result.
Check if '/c/d/e' is a sub-folder of '/c/d'.
'/c/f' is not a sub-folder of '/c/d'. Add to result.
